newsitem.title: USA: Cerner up on acquisition, merger overtures.
newsitem.headline: Cerner up on acquisition, merger overtures.

text.p: Cerner Corp stock rose as much as 2-1/4 Friday following the company's disclosure that it had received inquiries from several unidentified parties interested in acquisition or merger.
"The market is excited that Cerner might be selling, but I don't think they want to sell," said Kevin Dyches, an analyst at George K. Baum & Co.
Cerner, a Kansas City-based company that provides health care information systems, said its directors had adopted a shareholder rights plan in response to the overtures.
"They want to prove they can be worth more as an independent than as a subsidiary," Dyches said. "This shareholder rights plan could buy them the time they need to pull that off."
